questions.question: When testing custom handlers and rendering in in-app messages, how should you verify that analytics are correctly submitted?
options: Check the Custom Events page for the standard Braze value
Check Message Activity Log for entries
Send a test campaign and monitor Campaign Analytics
Verify with console.log() in your SDK integration
questions.explanation: The Message Activity Log provides detailed records of all message interactions and analytics submissions.

questions.question: Using the /users/track REST API, what is the maximum number of attributes you can update with a single API request given a 3,000 requests per second rate limit?
options: Less than 3,000 due to ID and auth overhead
Exactly 3,000 since the rate limit refers to attributes
More than 3,000 since each request can contain multiple attributes
It depends on the attribute data types
questions.explanation: Each API request can contain multiple user attribute objects, so you can update more than 3,000 attributes per second by batching them efficiently.
